Our Programs

Discover the perfect instrument for you or your child

Find Your Sound

At West Island Music School, we offer comprehensive music programs designed for students of all ages and skill levels. Whether you are a complete beginner or an advanced player looking to refine your technique, our experienced instructors will create a personalized learning plan just for you.

We offer flexible lesson packages to suit every schedule and budget. Contact us for current pricing and availability.
